physicalNotes: Radius 1.183 Jupiter radii from Yee et al. 2023 (2023ApJS..265....1Y), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....1Y/abstract): 84,575 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.794 Jupiter masses (Yee et al. 2023, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2023ApJS..265....1Y), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....1Y/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
